claimText:
Refine the `ela30-1-modern-drama` lesson navigation so the Lessons page is a preview library only and individual lesson pages are opened separately.

Goal:
- Keep `#lessons` as an 8-card lesson preview grid.
- Make each preview card click through to its own lesson hash/page.
- Remove the lesson detail panel from the bottom of the Lessons library page.
- Ensure individual lesson pages do not show the other lesson-card grid above the content.
- Preserve existing lesson content, media embeds, source links, completion buttons, and sidebar navigation.

Acceptance boundary:
- Edit the ELA Modern Drama generator and regenerated project only.
- Do not modify unrelated projects.
- Do not hand-edit raw Brightspace source files.

- `npm run stax:preflight -- --repo "C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\canvas-helper" --mode observer` from `C:\Users\dean.guedo\Documents\GitHub\STAX` - exit 0.

Command output summary with exit codes:
- Focused test passed: 3 tests, 0 failures.
- Generator built `ela30-1-modern-drama` with 8 lessons.
- Project verifier passed metadata policy and reported no missing local assets, no missing workspace embeds, and no missing course-shell resources. It reported expected external dependency warnings for Tailwind CDN and Google fonts/icons.
- Typecheck passed with `tsc --noEmit`.
- Studio production build passed with 51 modules transformed.
- Playwright confirmed the Resources route is visible, 2 embedded video frames are present on Resources, 7 source lesson images are present, the Doll's House lesson has a linked video embed, the Streetcar lesson has its original iframe embed, and 8 lesson cards render.
- STAX visual proof collected as `visual_2026-06-05T16_42_07_262Z_415f2a7b0054`.
- STAX observer preflight exited 0 but recorded verdict `Reject`; blocking was false. Reason: approval artifact missing plus stale historical command evidence for an unrelated old deploy proof remains in the sidecar ledger.

What is verified:
- The Modern Drama unit was extracted from the ELA 30-1 Brightspace ZIP.
- The workspace source of truth is `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/workspace/index.html`.
- The generated frame includes Overview, Lessons, Writing Studio, Readings, and Resources routes.
- The generated frame preserves 8 lesson cards, 7 local source images, one local HTML resource, and two YouTube embeds.
- The converter handles UTF-16 Brightspace HTML and D2L path quirks.
- The local browser preview renders the routed frame and media surfaces.
- STAX collected current rendered visual proof for this worktree.

What is weak/provisional:
- STAX observer verdict remains `Reject` because of missing approval artifact and stale historical command evidence unrelated to this ELA work.
- Video embeds depend on YouTube availability.
- Tailwind, Google fonts, and Material Symbols are still external runtime dependencies.

What is unverified:
- No Brightspace import/export package has been produced yet.
- No learner/gradebook persistence integration exists; lesson completion is local preview state.
- No full mobile device matrix was run beyond responsive CSS and desktop Playwright proof.

Risks:
- Some source external links are old HTTP/PDF links from the D2L export and need teacher review before publishing.
- Future D2L units may use different manifest anchors, so the generator may need a unit selector option for repeated use.
- If the local preview server is stopped, the preview URL in handoff will need a new running server.

One next action:
Pull the pushed commit from the home workstation and open `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/workspace/index.html` for the next authoring pass.
